findings.label_excerpt: Pain occasionally radiated to the inside of ipsilateral ear and lower jaw, not made worse by swallowing
findings.source_quote: The pain was constant and moderate in intensity and occasionally radiated to the inside of his ipsilateral ear and lower jaw. The pain was not made worse by swallowing, but it was exacerbated when he rotated his neck and opened his mouth widely.
findings.explanation: The symptom details omit the pain's constant, moderate character and its exacerbation with neck rotation and wide mouth opening; these are material symptom qualifiers.

findings.source_quote: He had had six episodes of this neck pain in the previous 5 years but had not visited his doctor because it had disappeared within a week each time.
findings.explanation: The physiological context captures migraines but omits the history of six prior episodes of the same neck pain over five years, a relevant recurrent symptom history.

initial.summary: Candidate material omissions include the medication frequency, symptom qualifiers, and recurrent neck-pain history.
